verdict.rationale: No documented bulk or batch operation exists. Paperspace does offer a REST API and an official CLI for managing resources programmatically, and custom templates for creating machines with the same specs, so users could script bulk actions themselves. That is a workaround, not native bulk support. Missing for 10: native bulk/batch endpoints or CLI commands acting on many items at once, documentation of multi-resource operations, an OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and hands-on corroboration.
